description: Downloads an issued (sales) invoice rendered by UOL and saves it on the machine running uol-mcp. format=isdoc also returns the ISDOC XML (Czech e-invoice standard), which is readable line by line. ISDOC exists only for issued (confirmed) invoices. Received invoices cannot be exported through the API.
name: export_sales_invoice

file_path.description: Absolute path of the saved file on the machine running uol-mcp; null when the file is embedded in the result (HTTP transport)

title: Export issued invoice (PDF / ISDOC)
